transcript: Speaker A: Sir platform number four पर कैसे जाना है? [Sir, how to go to platform number four?] Speaker B: Go upstairs, take the foot over bridge and then come down on platform number four. Speaker A: Sir समझा नहीं। English अच्छे से नहीं आती। [Sir, didn't understand. Don't know English well.] Speaker B: अरे आजकल के ज़माने में English समझना बहुत ज़रूरी है। सीख क्यों नहीं लेते? [Oh, in today's world, understanding English is very important. Why don't you learn?] Speaker A: Sir time ही नहीं मिलता। आपने कहाँ से सीखा? [Sir, I don't get time. Where did you learn from?] Speaker B: मैंने तो SpeakEasy app से सीखा है। ज़्यादा time नहीं चाहिए इस app पर। बस 10-15 मिनट practice करो and your English will get better in some days. [I learned from SpeakEasy app. You don't need much time on this app. Just practice 10-15 minutes and your English will get better in some days.] Speaker A: यह SpeakEasy app क्या है? [What is this SpeakEasy app?] Speaker B: इस app में Vani AI teacher है, जिसके साथ तुम बिना किसी judgement के English practice कर सकते हो। और best part कि ग़लती करोगे तो AI तुरंत correct भी कर देती है। [In this app, Vani is an AI teacher, with whom you can practice English without any judgment. And the best part is if you make a mistake, the AI corrects you immediately.] Speaker A: पर sir यह app तो costly होगा ना? [But sir, this app must be costly, right?] Speaker B: बिल्कुल नहीं। मैंने तो बस ₹1 में शुरू किया था। तुम भी कर सकते हो। [Not at all. I started for just ₹1. You can too.] Speaker A: कैसे start करूँ? [How do I start?] Speaker B: बस install button पर click करो, SpeakEasy app install करो and अपनी English learning journey शुरू करो। [Just click on the install button, install SpeakEasy app and start your English learning journey.] Speaker C: अभी SpeakEasy app download करें और फर्राटेदार English बोलना शुरू करें। [Download SpeakEasy app now and start speaking fluent English.]

summary: A young man at a railway station struggles to understand English directions from a ticket collector. The collector recommends the SpeakEasy app, explaining that it requires only 10-15 minutes of daily practice, features an AI teacher named Vani, and costs just ₹1 to start. The ad concludes with a call to action to download the app for fluent English speaking.
